apoapsis.ages.line.1: Metal is in hand. The colony can grow.
apoapsis.ages.line.2: Ironwork confirmed. New workbenches open up.
apoapsis.ages.line.3: Machines are running. Hulls, engines and fuel are open.
apoapsis.ages.line.4: Your first flight is done. Orbit is next.
apoapsis.ages.line.start: Build a ship: cockpit, tank and thruster. Fly above 1,500 m, then land it.
apoapsis.ages.line.pale: First landing on Pale recorded. A regolith sample brought home to Verdance unlocks the next Age.
apoapsis.firsts.orbit.line: Your orbit clears the atmosphere. It will hold.
apoapsis.firsts.pale_landing.line: Down on Pale. Bring something back.
apoapsis.firsts.pale_sample.line: Pale soil is home. Age 5 begins.
apoapsis.advancement.root.title: Apoapsis
apoapsis.advancement.root.description: The firsts, from the first flight to the first sample.
apoapsis.advancement.first_flight.title: First Flight
apoapsis.advancement.first_flight.descri: Fly a ship you built above 1,500 metres, then land it in one piece.
apoapsis.advancement.suborbital.title: Suborbital
apoapsis.advancement.suborbital.descript: Take a ship up from Verdance's surface into orbit.
apoapsis.advancement.orbit.title: Stable Orbit
apoapsis.advancement.orbit.description: Coast around Verdance with the engines off, clear of the atmosphere.
apoapsis.advancement.pale_flyby.title: Pale Flyby
apoapsis.advancement.pale_landing.title: Pale Landing
apoapsis.advancement.crewed_return.title: Crewed Return
apoapsis.advancement.crewed_return.descr: Land the same pilot back on Verdance after Pale.
apoapsis.advancement.pale_sample.title: Pale Sample
apoapsis.advancement.pale_sample.descrip: Bring a Pale regolith sample home to Verdance.
